text:
nina-eng: Deploybot blocked v5.2.0 for eu-west-1: missing SBOM attachment + 1 LOW transitive vuln. We have a 45min change window. Ideas?

deploybot: [automated] release v5.2.0 -> gates: SBOM_MANIFEST: NOT_ATTACHED; VULN_SCAN: 1 LOW (transitive). Action: HOLD (region: eu-west-1). pipeline: /pipelines/5512.

arnold-sec: Can someone fetch cosign output and the manifest annotation? Compliance will need artifact-level proof if we want an exception for EU.

leo-build: Ran quick checks: `cosign verify registry.redwood/v5.2.0` -> prints signature present but `io.redwood.sbom` annotation missing. SBOM exists in artifacts store but wasn't annotated on push.

tara-release: Ops options: (A) Defer EU and roll to other regions now, (B) timebox an exception with limited EU canary (1-2%) and auto-rollback guard, (C) rollback fully to v5.1.3. What's the risk appetite?

nina-eng: The vuln flagged is in a test fixture and not in runtime layers. I'd prefer B if Compliance will sign. I can assemble evidence bundle in 5m.

arnold-sec: Conditional approval for B: 1) evidence bundle in CHG ticket (cosign output, manifest, SBOM checksum), 2) limit EU to 1% canary and 30min observation window, 3) automated rollback to v5.1.3 on any security telemetry or if SBOM not attached within 24h. Post remediation proof when SBOM attached.

leo-build: I made a quick fix to publishing pipeline to attach SBOM as manifest annotation. PR #621 fixes it and will re-publish. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/publish/pull/621.

deploybot: [automated] note: if proceed with timeboxed-exception, tag release `v5.2.0-eu-timebox-exc` and schedule recheck in 24h. Auto-rollback target: v5.1.3.

tara-release: Creating CHG-5222 and uploading evidence when ready. Nina/Leo, paste links and I'll kick a 1% EU canary pending Arnold sign-off.

nina-eng: Evidence uploaded: https://internal.redwood/chg/CHG-5222/evidence.zip. Release note draft: "v5.2.0: EU limited canary due to SBOM annotation delay; low-risk transitive vuln only in test fixture; publishing fix PR #621; rollback scheduled if remediation not merged within 24h."

arnold-sec: Reviewed CHG-5222 evidence, posting conditional sign-off. :white_check_mark: Proceed with 1% EU canary and 30min monitoring window. Attach cosign logs to CHG when publish finishes.

tara-release: Rolling to allowed regions and starting EU 1% canary with tag `v5.2.0-eu-timebox-exc`. Monitoring enabled.

deploybot: [automated] rollout started -> regions: global-except-eu (full), eu-west-1 (1% canary). policy: timebox 24h for SBOM attach -> auto-rollback v5.1.3 if remediation not merged or security telemetry exceeds threshold.

nina-eng: Thanks. Will watch metrics and update CHG if we need to revert.

arnold-sec: Reminder: after SBOM attach, re-run `cosign verify` and upload output to CHG-5222 for final sign-off.
